verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no mention of an llms.txt file, markdown or agent-oriented documentation endpoints, or docs written for agent consumption. The MCP servers (Cloud Run MCP, MCP Toolbox) and Vertex AI agent-building material are different capabilities and do not count toward this story. Publishing agent-readable docs is a reasonable thing to expect from a cloud platform, so this is "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
